fit_rule_100ms.desc: confound figure panel B: championships whose 95% CI of the 1-in-1,000 barrier (men, ex-Gaussian) contains the 0.100 s rule

fit_fiore_094ms.desc: confound figure panel B: championships whose 95% CI of the 1-in-1,000 barrier (men, ex-Gaussian) contains 0.094 s (Fiore et al. 2025)

fit_brosnan_119ms.desc: confound figure panel B: championships whose 95% CI of the 1-in-1,000 barrier (men, ex-Gaussian) contains 0.119 s (Brosnan et al. 2017, upper)

fit_none.desc: confound figure panel B: championships whose barrier CI contains none of the three lines

barrier_below_rule.desc: confound figure panel B: championships whose barrier lies below 0.100 s (the rule flags more than 1 in 1,000 legitimate starts there)

barrier_above_rule.desc: confound figure panel B: championships whose barrier lies at or above 0.100 s

p1_unflagged_rt_min_s.desc: guard band cost (caption; not drawn): shortest RT among the recorded false starts a uniform guard band (P1) would no longer flag

p1_unflagged_rt_max_s.desc: guard band cost (caption; not drawn): longest RT among the recorded false starts a uniform guard band (P1) would no longer flag
